enrichment.summary: Sequoia Foundation will set up an outdoor air quality monitoring network across 75 district K-12 school sites, start a high school internship program for the sensors, and build a toolkit for high school air quality lessons. It runs March 15, 2024 through March 31, 2026 at no cost to the district.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: No-Cost Services Agreement - Sequoia Foundation - Outdoor Air Quality (OAQ) Monitoring Network - High School Linked Learning Office

enrichment.headline: Accepts a donated bus from the City of Oakland, valued at $1,275, for Manufacturing Day
enrichment.summary: The district accepts a donation from the City of Oakland: a sponsored bus to carry up to fifty students to the Oakland Manufacturing Day event on October 24, 2023. The donation is valued at $1,275.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Donation - City of Oakland - High School Linked Learning Office

enrichment.headline: Ratifies up to $10,700 for Outward Bound California ropes courses in summer credit recovery
enrichment.summary: The board is ratifying, after the agreement period began, a program agreement with Outward Bound California for Insight Ropes Courses that support the Summer Healing and Academics 4 Kids credit recovery programs and build students' confidence, compassion and social-emotional skills. It runs April 12 through June 30, 2024, with a cap of $10,700.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Program Agreement - Outward Bound California - Credit Academic Recovery (CAR) - High School Linked Learning Office

enrichment.headline: Approves student travel for three Skyline High students to visit the University of Hawaii, Hilo
enrichment.summary: The board approves a resolution authorizing Skyline High School to take three 9th-12th grade students to visit the University of Hawaii, Hilo, from July 7 through July 13, 2024. The text does not state a cost.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Student Travel - University of Hawaii-Hilo - Pacific Islander IKUNA Crew Club - Skyline High School

enrichment.headline: Accepts a $30,000 Intrepid Philanthropy grant for teacher training at Oakland Technical High
enrichment.summary: The district accepts $30,000 in Light Awards Program funding from the Intrepid Philanthropy Foundation for a teacher professional development project at Oakland Technical High School, focused on building teachers' shared effectiveness in supporting future social justice leaders. The grant term is April 1, 2024 through June 1, 2026.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Grant Agreement - Intrepid Philanthropy Foundation - Cultivating Our Collective Efficacy to Support Future Social Justice Leaders - Oakland Technical High School

enrichment.headline: Accepts a $30,000 Intrepid Philanthropy grant for teacher training at Madison Park Academy Upper
enrichment.summary: The district accepts $30,000 in Light Awards Program funding from the Intrepid Philanthropy Foundation for a teacher professional development project at Madison Park Academy - Upper, aimed at increasing student talk in the classroom. The grant term is April 1, 2024 through June 1, 2026.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Grant Agreement - Intrepid Philanthropy Foundation - Cultivating Conversation: Increasing Student Talk in the Classroom - Madison Park Academy-Upper Campus

enrichment.headline: Approves up to $15,000 for the National College Resources Foundation's HBCU college fairs
enrichment.summary: The district contracts with the National College Resources Foundation, with the NAACP and Oakland Promise, to bring at least 20 Historically Black Colleges and Universities to Oakland for two college fairs and an awards ceremony. Students may get on-the-spot scholarship offers and admissions. It runs November 1, 2023 through February 17, 2024, with a cap of $15,000.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2023-2024 - National College Resources Foundation (NCRF) - High School Linked Learning Department

enrichment.headline: Accepts $752,323 more from the state for the California State Preschool Program
enrichment.summary: The board accepts an increase of $752,323 to the district's California State Preschool Program contract with the California Department of Education, raising it from $25,590,700 to $26,343,023 for July 1, 2023 through June 30, 2024. The program is run by the Early Childhood Education Department.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.summary: The district accepts a $250,000 Middle College and Early College Grant from the California Department of Education for the high school network and alternative education. The grant covers July 1, 2023 through June 30, 2027. The purpose is described in an attachment that is not part of the text.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Grant Award - California Department of Education - Middle College and Early College Grant - High School Network, Alternative Education

enrichment.headline: Ratifies up to $14,000 for Oakland Interfaith Gospel Choir's choral music program at Claremont Middle
enrichment.summary: The district pays Oakland Interfaith Gospel Choir up to $14,000 to provide and evaluate a choral music program at Claremont Middle School. The agreement covers August 7, 2023 through May 23, 2024. The Board is approving it after the agreement period began.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2023-2024 - Oakland Interfaith Gospel Choir - Claremont Middle School

enrichment.headline: Extends George Hills' claims administration contract to June 2025 and adds free incident tracking
enrichment.summary: George Hills Company, which handles insurance claims for the district, will add monitoring of incident reports under Senate Bill 533 and send reminders to administrators at no added cost. The contract is extended one year, from June 30, 2024 to June 30, 2025. The text says the extra year carries a 3% annual increase on the current $370,000 yearly cost, but it does not state the new yearly amount.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.summary: The Board adopts a resolution accepting the Measure G1 oversight commission's recommendation to approve the 2024-2025 G1 application for named schools. Measure G1 is the Districtwide Teacher Retention and Middle School Improvement Act. The text does not list the schools or any dollar amounts.

enrichment.summary: The Board ratifies the written minutes of its regular meeting held on May 22, 2024. Staff prepared the minutes shortly after the meeting. There is no cost.
